name: Sweet Clown
source:
"I want to become one with you. I want to become your other half."

The person who invited everyone to the 3AM tea party.
They love tea parties very much and enjoy inviting people they find interesting to said tea parties.
They can be difficult to talk to because of their eccentricity, but despite that, their mannerisms seem very elegant and refined.
